f3_program: older_than(at("jessica.age", "now"), at("claire.age", "now"), 6, "year", source("Jessica is six years older than Claire"))
observe(at("claire.age", "plus_2_year"), 20, "year", source("In two years, Claire will be 20 years old"))
query("value", at("jessica.age", "now"))
collection("ben.cards", "card", "ben", source("Ben has four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))
observe(at("ben.basketball_card_boxes.count", "initial"), 4, "box", source("four boxes"))
observe(at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box", "initial"), 10, "card_per_box", source("ten basketball cards in each box"))

product_relation(at("ben.basketball_cards.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_card_boxes.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box", "initial"), source("four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))
observe(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_card_boxes.count", "gift"), 5, "box", source("five boxes"))
observe(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.per_box", "gift"), 8, "card_per_box", source("eight baseball cards"))

product_relation(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "gift"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_card_boxes.count", "gift"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.per_box", "gift"), source("five boxes with eight baseball cards"))

transfer("e1", "ben.mother", at("ben.mother.baseball_cards.count", "current"), at("ben.baseball_cards.count", "current"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "gift"), source("His mother gave him five boxes with eight baseball cards"))
member("ben.cards", "ben.basketball_cards", source("basketball cards"))
member("ben.cards", "ben.baseball_cards", source("baseball cards"))
transfer("e2", "ben", at("ben.cards.count", "current"), at("ben.classmates.cards.count", "current"), 58, source("he gives 58 cards to his classmates"))
query("remaining_count", "ben.cards", "current")
assumptions: The five gifted boxes are interpreted as containing eight baseball cards each.

f3_program: collection("singtel.acquisition_payments", "payment", "singtel", source("Payments of S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018 and S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))

observe(at("singtel.acquisition_payments.videology_assets.amount", "august_2018"), 123, "S$ million", source("Payments of S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018"))

observe(at("singtel.acquisition_payments.airtel_africa_equity_interest.amount", "october_2018"), 344, "S$ million", source("S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))
member("singtel.acquisition_payments", "singtel.acquisition_payments.videology_assets.amount", source("Payments of S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018"))

member("singtel.acquisition_payments", "singtel.acquisition_payments.airtel_africa_equity_interest.amount", source("S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))
query("sum", "singtel.acquisition_payments", "2018")
observe(at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_contents.weight", "full"), 250, "pound", source("a 250 pound sandbag"))
percent_of(at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_contents.weight", "current"), at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_contents.weight", "full"), 80, source("Tom fills a 250 pound sandbag 80% full"))

percent_more(at("tom.sandbag.filling_material.weight", "current"), at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_contents.weight", "current"), 40, source("the filling material he is using is 40% heavier than sand"))
query("value", at("tom.sandbag.filling_material.weight", "current"))
assumptions: The 250-pound rating denotes the contents weight when the bag is full of sand.
Contents weight scales uniformly with the filled proportion.
The empty bag's weight is excluded from the requested weight.

f3_program: collection("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "patron", "overflow_parking_lot", source("There are 12 patrons who came in cars and 27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_cars.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
observe(at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_bus.count", "current"), 27, "count", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
member("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_cars", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
member("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_bus", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("ellen.golf_cart.capacity.patrons", "current"), 3, "patron_per_cart", source("Ellen can fit 3 patrons in a golf cart"))
query("value", at("ellen.golf_carts.required.count", "current"))
assumptions: Each required golf cart is counted as one load carrying at most three patrons.
